name: What should I look for when choosing a contractor for cabin refinishing?

mainEntity.name: What should I look for when choosing a contractor for cabin refinishing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Look for a contractor who has direct experience with exterior wood finishes, log movement, and structural carpentry rather than just standard house painting. Check that they provide on-site leadership, hold positive business credentials such as BBB accreditation, and carry proper liability insurance. A reliable contractor will inspect log moisture levels, assess chinking condition, and explain preparation methods clearly. Working with an owner-operated team ensures clear communication regarding daily progress and keeps the focus on quality craft from prep to final topcoat.
acceptedAnswer.description: Select a contractor experienced in log carpentry and finish care who inspects wood health in person, maintains proper licensing and insurance, and manages the job on site.
